name: Fiery Blaze Enchantments

guaranteedRewards.name: Fiery Blaze Enchantment
tooltip: Use: Enchants a weapon to have a 15% chance to inflict 9 to 13 Fire damage to all enemies within 3 yards.

statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
As an apprentice to Feranor Steeltoe, I learned his special technique for imbuing weapons with fiery enchantments. Last I heard of him, he was working at a smithy with a hunting party up in Lordaeron.

I can't tell you too many of the details about the process, but I can tell you it requires blood from a rare, still-beating black drake whelp's heart. I don't have much to do waiting for word from Ironforge. If you bring me a heart from the whelps in Lethlor Ravine, I'll show you my skill!
narrative.objectives: Acquire a Black Drake's Heart for Sigrun Ironhew.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah yes, this will do excellently. This will enable your weapons to strike with searing heat!
